headline: Polymarket Traders Raise Odds of US-Iran Hormuz Deal to 34%
summary: Polymarket traders increased the probability of a US-Iran Hormuz deal by November 30 to 34%, up 10.5 points in a single day following the appearance of a draft framework.
why: Geopolitical agreements in key shipping routes such as the Strait of Hormuz can significantly influence energy supply stability and international trade flows.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Potential diplomatic agreements involving the Strait of Hormuz affect regional geopolitical risk.
